# @agents-js/skills

> TypeScript-native skill loading, validation, and in-memory registry for SKILL.md-formatted skills. Pure, filesystem-only, no network or persistence.

Canonical: https://agents-js.bodal.dev/per-package/agents-js-skills-llms.txt

---
# @agents-js/skills

> TypeScript-native skill loading, validation, and in-memory registry for SKILL.md-formatted skills. Pure, filesystem-only, no network or persistence.

## Installation

```sh
bun add @agents-js/skills
```

- **`loadSkill`** — Load a skill by name from the given search paths. Throws {SkillLoadError} if the skill is not found or if SKILL.md cannot be parsed.

### Interfaces

- **`LoadOptions`** — Options for {loadSkill}.
- **`Skill`** — A fully-loaded skill: metadata, frontmatter, and body.
- **`SkillFrontmatter`** — Canonical SKILL.md frontmatter shape after parsing. Unknown keys are preserved on the `extra` field so downstream consumers can read skill-system-specific metadata without forcing us to bless every...
- **`SkillMeta`** — Lightweight metadata for listing/enumeration. Does NOT include the body.
- **`SplitResult`** — Raw split of a SKILL.md document into frontmatter text + body. Returns `null` frontmatter when no valid fence is present so validators can report a specific "no frontmatter" error.
- **`StrictOptions`**
- **`ValidationResult`** — Result of a validation pass. `valid` is the aggregate verdict; `errors` are blocking issues; `warnings` are advisory.

### Types

- **`ParseFrontmatterResult`** — Parse result for the YAML block. Distinguishes the three failure modes validators care about: no fence, present-but-unparsable, and parsable-but-empty.

### Constants

- **`DESCRIPTION_MAX_LENGTH`**
- **`NAME_MAX_LENGTH`** — Tolerant validator limits. Strict mode tightens the lower bound.
- **`SKILL_FILENAME`** — Canonical filename for the SKILL authoring document. Lifted to a named constant so consumers can build paths without hardcoding the literal `"SKILL.md"`.
